summary: The comment opposes cutting the E-Rate program, citing its importance for schools and libraries and the negative impact on underfunded organizations.

claims.argument: Cutting E-Rate will harm underfunded schools and libraries
claims.evidence_quote: I am writing to express an objection to cutting the current e-rate for schools and libraries. Internet access is integral to being a productive member of society today. Students, teachers, and library staff all rely on the internet to learn, educated, and keep their organizations functioning. Schools and libraries are chronically underfunded; cutting e-rate will harm the organizations that make up the foundations of our education system.
